decision: Author one isolated conservative candidate justified by actual eight-case defect proof and independent candidate-worth A. No accepted source or CPU changes by this plan.
one_usable_improvement: Preserve saved data instead of normalizing unsafe remaining numbers; safely remove an unsafe target when remaining records are encodable, return its detached parsed data, and Undo exactly the validated original raw string.
bounded_research_question: Does the complete small guard/comparator/raw-Undo owner satisfy new numeric preservation, stale selection, refusal, raw size/errors/interleaving and return-detachment predicates while retaining all existing13groups/96supported-setting assertions?

chosen_contract.writer: Private module writer retains length limit and existing raw latest-read check/read/write errors; central commit refuses nonfinite/-0 anywhere in target configurations before JSON serialization. Rename retains its exact prior unsafe-number refusal, including no-op.
chosen_contract.comparison: Iterative structural selected-item comparison uses Object.is for leaves, distinguishes arrays/objects/null and retains ordered own-key matching equivalent to prior JSON key-order sensitivity. No new broad lexical comparison.
chosen_contract.undo: Store validated current.raw plus encoded after; guarded raw write restores exact original string, checks existing length/race/read/quota limits, clears Undo only on success.
chosen_contract.removed_return: Return the freshly parsed removed item; it shares no stored or raw Undo object. Caller mutation cannot change storage or raw Undo.
chosen_contract.preserved: Key/version/count/name/envelope/API, canonical supported options, finite unavailable configurations, no-op/Undo/error/staleness behavior, existing callers and all old assertions.

caps: At most300module lines,250added regression lines plus unchanged137existingtest lines (only candidate import redirected);64KiB per source, one30s CPU+5s cleanup/128MiB old-space/64KiB postcollection output.
regressions: Nonfinite and signed-zero nested/primitive guard; refused writes preserve exact current raw and prior Undo state; multiple unsafe remaining entries conservatively refuse removal.
Safe unsafe-target removal and exact source-raw Undo, with returned object mutation proving detachment.
Numeric stale expected snapshots reject null/zero replacements.
Raw Undo access/first-read/commit-read/quota errors and actual commit-time interleaving preserve current stored bytes and Undo record.
Exact permitted256Ki-codeunit source boundary restores raw; overlimit current storage refuses without writing.
All old13groups/96settings assertions retained without weakening.
alternatives: A small conservative owner is selected: simple auditable predicates, but actions can be refused while unsafe records remain and multiple such entries cannot necessarily be removed one at a time.
B full lexeme serializer deferred: more capable, much larger scanner/duplicate-key/depth/staleness proof.
stop: One coherent candidate and one independently reviewed bounded invocation. Unexpected test failure/timeout/uncollected/excess output stops this literal trial without test weakening or blind replay. No production adoption before actual result/root review.
limits: Specified decoded nonfinite/-0 safety and exact removal Undo, not arbitrary lexical/numeric precision, cross-tab atomicity, native UI or appearance acceptance. No browser/personal storage/network/GPU/backup candidate rescue. FullAAA/acceptedassets/frozen/original/unrelated preserved.
